q: The measure-theoretic sofic entropy and the topological sofic entropy are related by a variational principle (under appropriate conditions). For a sofic group G and G-action on a compact space X:
opts: htop_Σ(X) ≥ sup_μ h_Σ(μ,T) with equality for actions with a unique measure of maximal sofic entropy
The variational principle fails for all non-amenable groups
exp: The sofic variational principle: htop_Σ(X) ≥ sup_μ h_Σ(μ). Equality holds for many actions (e.g., subshifts with the specification property relative to the sofic approximation). This extends the classical variational principle to the sofic setting.
